steps.code:
handles = ["robotwin2:visual:38", "robotwin2:visual:46", "robotwin2:visual:54"]

for idx, p in enumerate(r_b1.output["points"]):
    q = p["pose"][3:]
    # try swapping (qw, qx) and (qy, qz), or negating, or using q directly at z=0.80:
    q_swap = [q[2], q[3], -q[0], -q[1]]
    q_swap2 = [q[2], -q[3], q[0], -q[1]]
    q_swap3 = [q[0], -q[1], q[2], -q[3]]
    for name_q, qq in [("orig_z80", q), ("swap", q_swap), ("swap2", q_swap2), ("swap3", q_swap3)]:
        pose = p["pose"][:2] + ([0.80] if name_q == "orig_z80" else [0.85]) + qq
        rp = primitives.call(
            name="probe_robotwin2_motion_plan", arm_tag="left", evidence_handles=handles, target_pose=pose
        )
        if rp.ok:
            print("b1 left idx", idx, name_q, "SUCCESS!", qq)
